I think I witnessed something I wasn’t supposed to see.
Should I go to Melissa and ask her what that was about?
Melissa: Just come out already.
Never mind. I guess she knew I was here all along.
You: Hi Melissa… What was that about? Are you in trouble?
Melissa: Nothing I won’t be able to take care of.
You: Are you sure? They seemed very motivated.
Melissa: They just want to cash in on the unsolved case bonus, that’s all. At some point they will give up.
You: Unsolved case bonus? What exactly did you get involved with?
#Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open
Melissa: Eh…
#Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm
Melissa: It’s just bad luck, that’s all. Two of my coworkers died in a short amount of time and now these two dorks think that I was somehow involved in it.
You: Died?!
Melissa: It’s not a big deal, really.
You: These cops seemed very serious about these accusations.
Melissa: I heard that the father of one of the dead coworkers is relatively rich and paid extra to the police to find the guilty person.
Melissa: Cops are no more than mercenaries these days. If they find the killer, they will get a huge payout, especially in this case.
#Cashier.Face.shocked
You: Sorry, I didn’t know you got involved in such a mess, but I’m glad that you decided to tell me about it. We will figure something out.
Melissa: I…
#Cashier.Face.normal
Melissa: I don’t know why I told you about it, but it was a mistake. Please forget it before you make things worse.
Melissa: Listen. I didn’t kill these people. I’m a bot. I’m sure you know that there are laws we cannot break no matter what and harming a human being is one of them.
Melissa: These stupid cops have no proof and just want to bully a confession out of me. It’s not going to happen. If I ignore them, they will just move on to the next case and forget about me.
You: Makes sense.
Melissa: So don’t tell anyone about this. Especially {f_botName}.
Melissa: Now, if you excuse me. I’m already late. Bye.
